<!-- Generative-null sharing test. Reads the SELECTION_TEST tables from the report bundle
     (bin/selection_test.py). Rendered on every route; CDR3beta in all of them. -->

# Selection against recombination bias {#sec-selection}

A CDR3 can appear in many people because it is easy to generate, not because an antigen selected
it. This section compares how many subjects carry each clonotype with how many the V(D)J
generation model predicts. **Selection candidates** are shared more than generation explains;
**generation-consistent** clonotypes are public, but no more than expected. A candidate is
evidence of excess sharing, not of what antigen drove it.

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

_sel = rb_read('compare', 'selection_test.tsv')
_sel_sum = rb_read('compare', 'selection_summary.tsv')
if _sel_sum is None:
    rb_note("The selection test did not run (produced by SELECTION_TEST).")
else:
    rb_table(_sel_sum.rename(columns={'metric': 'Metric', 'value': 'Value'}))
    if _sel is None:
        rb_note("No clonotype could be tested: see Status above.")
    else:
        rb_heading("Observed against expected sharing", 2)
        rb_text("Each point is a clonotype found in at least two subjects. Points on the dashed line "
                "are shared as often as generation predicts; candidates sit above it. Observed counts "
                "are whole numbers, so points form rows.")
        _d = _sel.sort_values('q_value', ascending=False)
        _d = pd.concat([_d[_d['call'] == 'selection_candidate'],
                        _d[_d['call'] != 'selection_candidate'].sample(min(20000, (_d['call'] != 'selection_candidate').sum()), random_state=1)])
        fig = go.Figure()
        for _call, _name, _col, _sym in (('generation_consistent', 'Consistent with generation', '#8c8c8c', 'circle'),
                                         ('selection_candidate', 'Selection candidate', '#d95926', 'diamond')):
            _g = _d[_d['call'] == _call]
            fig.add_trace(go.Scattergl(x=_g['expected_k'], y=_g['k'], mode='markers', name=_name,
                                       marker=dict(color=_col, symbol=_sym, size=6, opacity=0.7),
                                       text=_g['junction_aa'],
                                       hovertemplate='%{text}<br>Expected %{x:.2f}, observed %{y}<extra></extra>'))
        _top = float(max(_d['k'].max(), _d['expected_k'].max()))
        _low = float(max(_d['expected_k'].min(), 1e-6))
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[_low, _top], y=[_low, _top], mode='lines', name='Observed = expected',
                                 line=dict(color='#222222', dash='dash', width=1), hoverinfo='skip'))
        _rb_layout(fig, "Sharing against the generative null", 520,
                   xaxis=dict(title='Expected subjects', type='log'), yaxis=dict(title='Observed subjects', type='log'))

        rb_heading("Most public clonotypes", 2)
        rb_text("The clonotypes shared by the most subjects, which descriptive summaries would highlight, "
                "with what the test concludes about each.")
        _cols = {'junction_aa': 'CDR3b', 'k': 'Subjects', 'expected_k': 'Expected', 'log10_pgen': 'log10 Pgen',
                 'q_value': 'q', 'call': 'Call'}
        rb_table(_sel.sort_values(['k', 'q_value'], ascending=[False, True]).head(25)[list(_cols)].rename(columns=_cols).round(3))
        rb_heading("Top selection candidates", 2)
        _cand = _sel[_sel['call'] == 'selection_candidate']
        if _cand.empty:
            rb_note("No clonotype exceeded the generative null at this FDR.")
        else:
            rb_table(_cand.head(50)[list(_cols)].rename(columns=_cols).round(3))
```
